Upgrading to go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk@v1.40.0 introduces breaking API changes that are incompatible with tempo 2.10.1 codebase. The new version requires an Enabled() method on Int64Counter that tempo's code doesn't implement. Requires upstream tempo code changes to support the new OpenTelemetry API.
